left.raw_text: Aged 25-80 at screening. Subjects older than 80 will be allowed at the discretion of the PI.
Ambulatory (defined as able to ambulate at least 10 meters, with or without assistance).
Clinical Diagnosis of PD based on the United Kingdom Brain Bank diagnostic criteria for PD.

right.raw_text: At least 8 micturitions per 24 hours and

left.raw_text: At least 3 urgency episodes per 3-day diary.
A MoCA score between 19 and 28 (inclusive) at screening.
For those on cognitive enhancers (donepezil, rivastigmine, memantine, galantamine) a MoCA score between 19 and 29 (inclusive) at screening.
